presentation.label: Live waveform on DOWN + TEMPO
presentation.summary: Hold DOWN and press TEMPO for a full-screen scope of the selected track: OSC, XY or ALL eight tracks, with GAIN and TIME on A and B.
presentation.overview: SCOPE opens a full-panel window over the page and plots the selected audio track after its effects and before its fader. OSC draws a mono polyline, XY plots left against right, and ALL shows eight mini level strips in track-pad order. Encoder A sets GAIN, encoder B sets TIME. Push A to reset GAIN and clear the peak hold. Release CUE to toggle the G/P HUD. UP and DOWN cycle the three views; RIGHT shows help and LEFT returns.
highlights: DOWN + TEMPO opens OSC, XY or ALL without using an effect slot.
GAIN and TIME on A and B; push A clears the peak; CUE release toggles G/P.
usage: Hold [DOWN] and press [TEMPO] to open SCOPE on the selected audio track.
Turn DATA ENTRY A for GAIN and B for TIME; press [UP] or [DOWN] to switch OSC, XY and ALL.
Press [TEMPO], [YES] or [NO] to close, or hold [DOWN] and press [TEMPO] again.

access.location: Front panel: hold DOWN first, then press TEMPO.
steps: Select an audio track that is making sound. No effect slot is required.

controls.name: GAIN
controls.doc: Vertical scale for OSC and XY. Centre (20) is 0 dB; 0..40 is about ±20 dB. Push A resets to centre and clears the peak hold.

controls.name: TIME
controls.doc: How much of the ring maps across the panel. Higher values show a longer stretch of audio.

controls.name: VIEW
controls.doc: OSC is a mono polyline of the selected track. XY is left against right. ALL is eight mini strips in track-pad order.

limitations: 0.2.0 uses core hooks (module_key, module_tick) and ev_usb_frame instead of patching TEMPO, the frame tail and the UI loop, so Tuner can share a set. ev_usb_frame must run every audio block on the base you test; confirm on a development twin before claiming hardware proof.
0.1.0-experimental patched three stock sites and listed Tuner as a conflict; see git history and PR #2182.
Hold DOWN before TEMPO. Pressing TEMPO alone opens the stock tempo window.
XY uses a hotter vertical scale than OSC. Clip ! appears only when the recent peak reaches 0 dBFS.
DRAM unit: on a card build without another DRAM module, choosing SCOPE creates the platform DRAM reserve from Flex sample RAM (same class of cost as Tuner).
No device:qualify run or monochrome UI captures yet. At-rest CPU price was measured on an MKII; the transport state during the B02 measurement is unresolved.

storage.label: ColdFire code
storage.conditions: The tested USB package f8a1ffeb contains 37,704 bytes of ColdFire code and data and no BSS, according to its package header. This figure excludes stack and any base-owned memory reused at runtime.

processing.label: ColdFire worst event
processing.conditions: Window open on OSC/XY/ALL; worst event 602 cycles of 9577 per 16-sample block (evidence/performance.json, perf.py on 27 November 2026).

impact.conditions: One open SCOPE window on the selected audio track; worst ColdFire event 602 cycles per 16-sample block.

cpu.rationale: Frame interrupt copies 16 stereo samples into a ring while open; the UI task redraws about 60 Hz. perf:audit records 602 cycles per block against a 9577 allowance. At-rest frame interrupt on base 311bb670 moved 0.1 point (evidence/cpu-price.json).

dsp.rationale: No DSP program or effect slot. Reads the existing audio read-back arena.

memory.rationale: One DRAM unit with stereo rings and draw state; about 75 KB combined from disassembly and the package header. Creates the DRAM platform reserve when alone on the card.

cpuPrice.conditions: the bank, pattern and Part the unit was on, transport stopped (test:procedure); base Octatrack base 311bb670, MKII, OS 1.40C; 3 readings of 8 s a state. Frame interrupt 32.9 % before, 33 % installed and used nowhere; CPU meter 45.1 % before, 45 % at rest.

tests.summary: SCOPE 0.2.0 package f8a1ffeb ran on an MKII on 27 November 2026. npm run test:procedure on base 311bb670 passed unit steps 6–10. perf:audit records 602 cycles per block (static bound 650). Hardware LCD captures and release-base trials are in TESTING.md.

conditions.parameterExtremes: GAIN at 0 and 40, TIME at 0 and 9, VIEW on ALL (eight mini strips). Frame hook cost is fixed; draw path varies by view.
conditions.parameterModulation: Encoder turns change GAIN/TIME/VIEW while open; frame hook does not depend on knob values.
conditions.modeSwitching: DOWN+TEMPO open and close; UP/DOWN cycle views; YES/TEMPO/NO close.
conditions.maxLoad: One global instance. Development twin 43ac2465 with stereo line-in on T1 THRU, transport playing.
conditions.inputConditions: 440 Hz line-in; ALL view with eight tracks is the heaviest frame path.

regions.name: Runtime package code and data (ABI 8 header)
UI-task stack below sc_draw (disassembly bound, no canary)

memory.conditions: Assembled unit.s with MODWERK_EVENTS=1; package header from f8a1ffeb. Stack is a bound from sc_draw movem, not a hardware canary.

hardware.summary: On an MKII, 27 November 2026: test procedure on base 311bb670 passed steps 6–10 (trial, soak, price, restore). Development-twin trials, open-window gap reading, and LCD captures are in TESTING.md. Audio dropout counts and chip canary are not claimed.
limitations: Emulator cycles and load rows are not hardware timing.
MAIN/CUE USB capture for dropouts was not run in the procedure.
Transport state during the at-rest CPU price on base 311bb670 is unresolved in the log.
DRAM platform reserve when SCOPE is the only ColdFire unit is described in the README; not re-measured on every base.
